tools.name: convert_date
tools.description: Convert a date between the Gregorian, Hebrew, Islamic (Hijri), Chinese lunisolar, Persian (Solar Hijri), Indian national, Ethiopian and Coptic calendars. Give a Gregorian "date" (YYYY-MM-DD), or "calendar" with "year", "month" (number or name, e.g. "Kislev", "Ramadan", "Farvardin") and "day". Use it for questions like "what is the Hebrew date of my birthday" or "when is 1 Ramadan 1448 in the Gregorian calendar". More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

method.description: Islamic method: umalqura (default, Saudi Arabia's official calendar), civil or tabular.

afterSunset.description: True when the time is after sunset: Hebrew and Islamic dates move to the next day (their days begin at sunset).
